outbound_relationship_limits.note: Per object, counted on valid outbound relationships only. Exceeding soft_limit produces a non-fatal warning ('consider simplifying'); exceeding hard_limit is a validation error. See /validators/src/rules/relationships.ts.

relationship_types.description: The source object came into being as a direct consequence of the target object.
The risk represented by the source object is reduced by the target object.
The source object is put into practice through the target object.
The source object fulfils the requirement described by the target control.
The source object cannot be considered satisfied without producing the target evidence type.
The source object implies a question that board-level oversight should ask.
A general, non-hierarchical association between two objects that doesn't fit a more specific verb. Symmetric in meaning, but must still be declared explicitly on at least one side.

cycle_detection_scope_note: Cycle detection runs separately for each verb in acyclic_verbs, not across the union of them. Two different verbs pointing in opposite directions between the same pair of objects (e.g. 'decision RESULTED_FROM incident' and 'incident MITIGATED_BY decision') encode two distinct, simultaneously-true facts, not a logical loop. A genuine cycle is a chain of edges that all share one verb and loop back on themselves (e.g. decision-A RESULTED_FROM decision-B RESULTED_FROM decision-A).
